datasets.name: champion_stats
queryLines:
SELECT
    champion_id,
    champion_name,
    most_picked_lane,
    ROUND(primary_lane_share * 100, 2) AS primary_lane_share,
    global_games_played,
    ROUND(global_pick_rate * 100, 2) AS global_pick_rate,
    ROUND(global_win_rate * 100, 2) AS global_win_rate,
    ROUND(global_ban_rate * 100, 2) AS global_ban_rate
FROM league_records.gold.champion_overviews

datasets.name: purchase_timing_top_items
queryLines:
WITH top_items AS (
  SELECT
    item_name
  FROM
    league_records.gold.item_recommendations
  GROUP BY
    item_name
  ORDER BY
    AVG(player_purchase_rate) DESC
  LIMIT 15
)
SELECT
  ir.item_name,
  AVG(ir.most_common_first_purchase_minute) AS avg_purchase_minute
FROM
  league_records.gold.item_recommendations ir
    INNER JOIN top_items ti
      ON ir.item_name = ti.item_name
GROUP BY
  ir.item_name
ORDER BY
  AVG(ir.most_common_first_purchase_minute) ASC

datasets.name: item_overview_counters
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT item_name) AS total_unique_items,
  COUNT(DISTINCT champion_name) AS total_champions,
  ROUND(AVG(win_rate) * 100, 2) AS avg_win_rate_pct
FROM
  league_records.gold.item_recommendations

datasets.name: top_15_items_winrate
queryLines:
SELECT
  champion_name,
  item_name,
  item_category,
  ROUND(AVG(win_rate) * 100, 2) AS win_rate_pct
FROM
  league_records.gold.item_recommendations
GROUP BY
  champion_name,
  item_name,
  item_category

datasets.name: item_recommendations_main
queryLines:
SELECT
  champion_name,
  item_name,
  item_category,
  ROUND(player_purchase_rate * 100, 2) AS purchase_rate_pct,
  ROUND(win_rate * 100, 2) AS win_rate_pct,
  ROUND(avg_kda, 2) AS avg_kda,
  most_common_first_purchase_minute,
  top_item_1,
  top_item_2,
  top_item_3
FROM
  league_records.gold.item_recommendations

datasets.name: top_15_items_purchase
queryLines:
SELECT
  champion_name,
  item_name,
  item_category,
  ROUND(AVG(player_purchase_rate) * 100, 2) AS purchase_rate_pct
FROM
  league_records.gold.item_recommendations
GROUP BY
  champion_name,
  item_name,
  item_category

datasets.name: match_browser_main
queryLines:
SELECT
  m.match_id,
  m.game_date,
  m.game_duration,
  m.game_version,
  m.winning_team,
  m.average_rank,
  CONCAT_WS(
    ', ',
    COLLECT_LIST(DISTINCT
      CASE
        WHEN p.team = 'BLUE' THEN p.champion_name
      END
    )
  ) AS blue_champions,
  CONCAT_WS(
    ', ',
    COLLECT_LIST(DISTINCT
      CASE
        WHEN p.team = 'RED' THEN p.champion_name
      END
    )
  ) AS red_champions,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN p.team = 'BLUE' THEN p.kills
    END
  ) AS blue_kills,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN p.team = 'RED' THEN p.kills
    END
  ) AS red_kills
FROM
  league_records.silver.matches m
    LEFT JOIN league_records.gold.matchend_player_stats p
      ON m.match_id = p.match_id
GROUP BY
  m.match_id,
  m.game_date,
  m.game_duration,
  m.game_version,
  m.winning_team,
  m.average_rank
ORDER BY
  m.game_date DESC

datasets.name: match_champions_filter
queryLines:
SELECT DISTINCT
  champion_name
FROM
  league_records.gold.matchend_player_stats
WHERE
  champion_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  champion_name

datasets.name: match_champions
queryLines:
SELECT DISTINCT
  m.match_id,
  p.champion_name
FROM
  league_records.gold.matchend_pivot_teamstats m
    JOIN league_records.gold.matchend_player_stats p
      ON m.match_id = p.match_id
WHERE
  p.champion_name IS NOT NULL

datasets.name: match_dossiers
queryLines:
SELECT
  match_id,
  game_date,
  ROUND(game_duration / 60.0, 1) AS game_duration_mins,
  game_version,
  winning_team,
  average_rank,
  blue_kills,
  blue_towers,
  blue_inhibitors,
  blue_dragons,
  blue_void_grubs,
  blue_heralds,
  blue_barons,
  red_kills,
  red_towers,
  red_inhibitors,
  red_dragons,
  red_void_grubs,
  red_heralds,
  red_barons,
  winning_gold_diff
FROM
  league_records.gold.matchend_pivot_teamstats
ORDER BY
  game_date DESC
